subject: general
question: On 9 November 2023, N Srikant was appointed as the Additional Secretary in the Union Ministry of ________.

options.text: Power and New and Renewable Energy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Power and New and Renewable Energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Ministry of Power and New and Renewable Energy is a crucial arm of the Indian government responsible for the development and management of the power sector, including both conventional and renewable energy sources. Here's a detailed look at this important ministry: 
 
• **Formation and Mandate:**
 
• Origins: The Ministr y of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) was initially established in 1982 as the Department of Non-conventional Energy Sources (DNES). It was later upgraded to a full-fledged ministry in 2006, recognizing the growing importance of renewable energy.
 
• Dual Responsibility: In 2021, the Ministry of Power and the MNRE were merged, bringing both conventional power generation and renewable energy development under one umbrella. This integration aimed to streamline policy and promote a holistic approach to energy security and sustainability.
 
• Key Functions: The ministry's mandate encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, including:
 
• Policy formulation and implementation for the power sector 
 
• Development and promotion of renewable energy technologies 
 
• Regulation of the electricity sector
 
• Energy conservation and efficiency
 
• Research and development in the power and renewable energy sectors 
 
• International cooperation in the energy sector

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Inf ormation__**

 
• **Leadership and Structure:**

 
 
• Current Minister: Shri Pralhad Joshi is the current Union Cabinet Minister holding charge of both the Ministry of Power and the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy. He assumed office in June 2024. 
 
• Minister of State: Shri Shripad Yesso Naik serves as the Minister of State in both ministries. 
 
• Secretary: Ms. Nidhi Khare, IAS, is the Secretary of both the Ministry of Power and the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
 
• Organizational Structure: The ministry comprises various wings and divisions that handle specific areas, such as:
 
• Renewable Energy
 
• Power
 
• Planning and Research
 
• Administration and Finance
